title: A Day at the Park
passageText: Yesterday, Sarah went to the park. It was a sunny and beautiful day. She brought a small basket with sandwiches and apples. First, she walked around the large lake. She saw many ducks swimming in the water. She threw some bread to the ducks, and they quacked happily. After that, she found a big oak tree and sat under its shade to eat her lunch. While she was eating, a small squirrel approached her. Sarah gave it a piece of apple. The squirrel took the apple quickly and ran up the tree. It was a very peaceful afternoon.
